[[File:38. Tagung 1988 Physik; Portrait Wolfgang Demtröder - W134Nr.125729c - Willy Pragher (cropped).jpg|thumb|Image of  Wolfgang Demtröder ]]
'''Wolfgang Demtröder''' (b. 5 September 1931 in [[Attendorn]]) is a German physicist and spectroscopist. He is the author of several textbooks on laser [[spectroscopy]] and a series of four textbooks on [[experimental physics]]. His books entitled ''Laserspektroskopie''<ref>W. Demtröder, ''Laserspektroskopie: Grundlagen und Techniken'', 5th Ed. (Springer, 2007).</ref> and ''Laser Spectroscopy''<ref>W. Demtröder, ''Laser Spectroscopy: Basic Principles'', 4th Ed. (Springer, 2008).</ref><ref>W. Demtröder, ''Laser Spectroscopy: Experimental Techniques'', 4th Ed. (Springer, 2008).</ref> are considered classics in the field. From 1970 til 1999, he was ordinary professor at [[Kaiserslautern University of Technology]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.uni-protokolle.de/nachrichten/id/52588/ |title=Kaiserslauterer Physik-Professor Dr. Wolfgang Demtröder emeritiert |access-date=2012-02-20 |archive-date=2016-04-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160407144620/http://uni-protokolle.de/nachrichten/id/52588/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> Awarded the [[Max Born Prize]] in 1994.
